scope: All five pages of live server-wide link search read. Discord search boundaries are local-date filters and include some early Paris references. This is not a full-message coverage certificate.
findings: Reconciles existing Kaguya/Nu11, YersonCz, Unreal91, Sam F and Tomegome video leads.
Dark and Astre screenshots and original contemporary leaderboard are already preserved or have specific recovery gaps.
Named ranked-score streams, combo videos, pipe pulls and official promotional videos are not TT WR proof.
Some links have generic unavailable titles, requiring surrounding context rather than title-only classification.
Generic Discord previews for iOoIe_fdt5g and SKBhcIy2Ie8 did not mean the underlying videos were unavailable. Original metadata resolves both as non-TT videos.
remaining: Missing Nova originals and documentary Discord attachment references still unresolved.
This link census supplements existing image census; it does not establish every message was captured.

resolvedGenericVideoLinks.title: NBC - x92 combo
resolvedGenericVideoLinks.description:
I dropped the combo at the end, but this is a good place to start when trying to build some good scores (sorry for cutting off the final score, it was 17,982).

The place where I got both of my frenzies can also be done in a combo, so this entire track can be done without the need of a frenzy.

context.finding: Nearby discussion concerns glider level, keeping a combo, and a combo break at video 1:37. Metadata explicitly reports ranked score 17,982.

additionalLinkClassification.title: Clutch WR vs ghost
additionalLinkClassification.description: The hardest I've ever worked to get ahead, in any game. I've been playing for days and was starting to get frustrated after 50 WR fails. Last lap is 29.297, the only 29.2 I've ever had. The last corner was all frame perfect I think. Being behind by 0.081 on MK8 into lap 3 is huge and even more on this track, it was very unlikely I'd have got ahead. One of the toughest grinds in a while, shame the run isn't great overall.
